title: CSV line parser
prompt: Write `parseCsvLine(line)`: split one CSV line into an array of field strings. Fields may be double-quoted; inside quotes, commas are literal and doubled double-quotes mean one literal quote. Unquoted fields are taken verbatim. Assume well-formed input. Reply with exactly one JavaScript code block (```js ... ```) that uses `export function` for the required function. ES module syntax, no external imports, no I/O, no comments needed.
